sloka: प्रहृष्ट वदनो राजा ततः अर्घ्यम् उपहारयत् ।स राज्ञः प्रतिगृह्य अर्घ्यम् शास्त्र दृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥१-१८-४४॥
transliteration: prahṛṣṭa vadano rājā tataḥ arghyam upahārayat ।sa rājñaḥ pratigṛhya arghyam śāstra dṛṣṭena karmaṇā ॥1-18-44॥

translations.english: The exceedingly virtuous sage Viswamitra enquired from the king about the treasury welfare of his subjects living in cities and villages, and the well being of his friends and relatives.
